headline: 今日影剧：新片新剧齐发，续作待映
summary: 本周电影热作有《泥面人》《荒野丛林》《克拉拉与太阳》等；新剧《最低工资》《雅嘎疑云》《幻视任务》首播，热播剧《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》持续吸睛，待映片单还包括《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《泥面人》《荒野丛林》《克拉拉与太阳》《三星堆：未来往事》《象行记》领衔本周片单。
industryHighlights.en: Film highlights: Clayface, Wildwood, Klara and the Sun, Sanxingdui: Future Past, and Elephant Journey lead this week's slate.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《最低工资》《雅嘎疑云》《幻视任务》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New series premieres: Minimum Wage, Yaga Mystery, and Vision Quest launch this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》《魔女嘉莉》《菜鸟老警》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: Popular series: Reacher, Crystal Lake, Carrie, and The Rookie keep drawing viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《哥斯拉-0.0》及《银翼杀手2099》《再婚皇后》受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Coming soon: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Godzilla -0.0, Blade Runner 2099, and The Remarried Empress draw attention.

headlineEn: Today in Film & TV: New Releases and Sequels Await
summaryEn: This week's film highlights include Clayface, Wildwood, and Klara and the Sun; new series Minimum Wage, Yaga Mystery, and Vision Quest premiere, while Reacher and Crystal Lake remain popular. Upcoming films include Avengers 5 and Dune 3.
